Identified as this saint because: A 12th-13th-century icon from Saint Catherine's Monastery, Sinai, titled on Commons 'Saint James Intercisus' and filed in Category:James Intercisus. Intercisus ('the cut-to-pieces') is the Latin epithet of James the Persian, the great martyr of 27 November. Commons describes it: Saint James Intercisus.
